column1: # Hand area lights for the lighting module (deployed to pst_forever\assets\lighting\arealights.tsv):
# baked lights placed by hand where the GemRB lights stage found none (or missed one). They join the
# area's lights.txt lights: same flicker, occlusion, painted glow (at x, y - z) and light budget.
# Fields after the WED are those of a lights.txt "light" line, in area pixels:
# WED     x     y     z    radius  r     g     b     strength  kind    shadow
# AR0508 cave mouth: pale daylight in the opening (GemRB LIGHTING_PLAN 14: missed after two tries).
# AR1202 the glowing sphere on its pedestal (cyan, centre 945,1085).
# AR0206 the candle stand by the back wall.
